title: Git-Backed Catalog Extension
description: STAC extension declaring that a Portolan catalog's source of truth is a git repository, plus how to contribute to and subscribe to it. Additive; valid on Catalog and Collection objects.

git:repository.description: Source repository URL (catalog source of truth).

git:ref.description: Branch or tag the catalog is built from.

git:edit_url.description: Deep link to edit this collection's source (Collection scope).
